rows.q: My mobile internet is really slow, what can I do?
rows.answer:
Slow internet can be caused by congestion, low signal, or having used your high-speed data allowance. Try these steps:
1. Turn airplane mode on, wait a few seconds, then turn it off to force a network reconnect.
2. Check your data usage; if you’ve reached your high-speed cap, speeds are throttled to 512 kbps (standard plans) or 1 Mbps (premium plans).
3. If you’re in a low-signal area, move to a location with better coverage.
4. If the issue persists during peak hours, it may be network congestion—speed should improve later.
If none of these help, contact support on 611 for further assistance.

rows.q: How do I check how much data I have left?
rows.answer:
You can check your remaining data balance in two ways:
1. Dial *123# from your phone and follow the prompts.
2. Open the MyTelecom app, go to “My Usage,” and view the data balance on the dashboard.

rows.q: What happens when I use up my high-speed data?
rows.answer: When you reach the high-speed data allowance in your plan, your connection is throttled for the rest of the billing cycle. Standard plans drop to about 512 kbps and premium plans to about 1 Mbps. You’ll still have internet access, but it won’t support video streaming or large downloads.

rows.q: My hotspot isn't working even though my plan includes it
rows.answer: Your hotspot may be blocked because the device’s APN isn’t set for tethering. We previously sent step-by-step APN settings for Android devices, which need to be entered on the phone. After updating the APN, restart the device and try the hotspot again. Hotspot usage draws from the same data allowance as regular usage, unless your plan has a separate hotspot sub-allowance. If it still doesn’t work, an agent can verify the APN and your plan’s hotspot allowance.

rows.q: I lost internet after switching my phone to 4G mode
rows.answer:
Try these steps:
1. Go to Settings > Mobile Network > Preferred Network Type and ensure 4G/LTE is selected.
2. Toggle Airplane mode on, wait a few seconds, then turn it off.
3. Reset your APN settings to the default (internet.telecom.example).
If the problem continues, an agent can assist further.

rows.q: Some app used all my data in a few days in the background
rows.answer: A background app can consume a lot of data. You can restrict background data per app in Android settings and enable Data Saver mode on your account as a safeguard, as we did in a similar case. This will stop apps from syncing large amounts without your consent.

rows.q: Why is my bill higher than usual?
rows.answer: Common reasons for a higher bill: international roaming charges, premium SMS subscriptions, additional data packs purchased mid-cycle, or a plan change. Go to Billing > Itemised Bill in the app to see a full breakdown.

rows.q: When is my bill due?
rows.answer: Your bill is generated on your monthly anniversary date and payment is due 14 days later. You can see your exact due date in the MyTelecom app under Billing > Current Bill.

rows.q: How do I download an itemised bill?
rows.answer: Log in to MyTelecom > Billing > Download Bill and select PDF. The PDF will contain the itemised bill showing every call, SMS and data session with date, time and cost. Bills are available for the last 12 months.

rows.q: If I upgrade my plan mid-month how am I billed?
rows.answer: When you upgrade, the new plan takes effect at the start of your next billing cycle, and you’ll be billed for the new plan then. Upgrading mid-month won’t change your current bill; the charge applies from the next cycle onward.

rows.q: How do I set up autopay?
rows.answer:
1. Open the MyTelecom app.
2. Go to Billing > Payment Methods.
3. Add a credit or debit card.
4. Enable AutoPay.
You’ll get an SMS reminder 3 days before each payment is taken.

rows.q: There's a charge for some SMS subscription I never signed up for
rows.answer: It looks like the charge may be from a premium SMS subscription, which can happen if a third-party service was subscribed to via a click-to-subscribe link. You can view the details in the app under Billing > Itemised Bill. If you didn’t authorize this, please call us on 611 right away so an agent can investigate and secure your account.

rows.q: How long does it take for a new SIM to activate?
rows.answer: A new SIM usually activates within 15 minutes after you insert it. If it’s still not active after 1 hour, try restarting your phone; if it remains inactive, call 611 and provide the SIM serial number printed on the card.

rows.q: My eSIM QR code keeps failing to scan
rows.answer: Each eSIM QR code can be used only once. If the scan fails, do not keep retrying the same code. Request a fresh activation code (or new QR code) via live chat in the MyTelecom app or by calling 611, then scan it while staying connected to Wi-Fi. On iPhone go to Settings > Mobile Data > Add eSIM.

rows.q: Phone says SIM not detected after I restarted it
rows.answer:
1. Power off your phone.
2. Remove the SIM card and reseat it firmly.
3. Power the phone back on.
If the problem continues, try the SIM in another phone to see if the SIM is damaged. If the SIM works elsewhere, the phone’s SIM tray or slot may be faulty.

rows.q: Can I keep my number if I switch to NovaCell?
rows.answer: Yes, you can keep your number when switching to NovaCell. Number porting is free and usually completes within 2 hours on working days. Start the port by calling 611 or visiting a store, and keep your old SIM active until you receive an SMS confirming the port is complete.

rows.q: My SIM was stolen, what do I do?
rows.answer: Call 611 right away to block the stolen SIM. Then visit any NovaCell store with a valid photo ID to get a replacement SIM; a $5 fee applies and your number and plan will transfer automatically.

rows.q: How do I turn on international roaming?
rows.answer:
1. Open the MyTelecom app.
2. Go to MyTelecom > Plan & Services > International Roaming.
3. Toggle the International Roaming switch on (do this at least 24 hours before you travel).
4. Choose a roaming bundle/pass to avoid per-MB charges.
5. Roaming will turn off automatically when you return home. You can also enable it by calling 611.

rows.q: I have no signal at all in Tokyo even though roaming is on
rows.answer:
Please try these steps:
1. Navigate to Settings > Mobile Network > Network Selection > Automatic.
2. Ensure roaming is enabled in your account.
If you still have no service, your plan may only allow roaming in Europe. An agent can extend roaming to Asia-Pacific and add a Japan daily bundle. Call 611 for help.

rows.q: How much does the International Day Pass cost?
rows.answer: The International Day Pass costs $10 per day, per line.

rows.q: I got roaming charges even though I bought a bundle
rows.answer: If you used data or made calls abroad before your roaming bundle was activated, those minutes/MB are billed at the standard roaming rates and aren’t reversed when the bundle starts later that day. Your itemised bill (Billing > Itemised Bill in the app) shows when the bundle activated and when your first usage occurred. If you think the bundle was active earlier, contact support on 611 so an agent can review it.

rows.q: Why can't I make international calls?
rows.answer: International calls are blocked because the International Calling add-on isn’t enabled on your account. Log in to the portal, go to Add-ons > International Calling and activate it. Once enabled, calls are billed per-minute by country unless you have an International Calling Pack, which provides discounted or unlimited rates for many destinations. If you need help adding the pack, you can also call 611.

rows.q: My calls keep dropping
rows.answer:
Call drops are often caused by weak signal, SIM card faults, or a faulty device antenna. Try these steps:
1. Restart the phone
2. Reseat the SIM
3. Test with another SIM if possible
4. Check for network outages via the app

rows.q: How do I turn on Wi-Fi calling?
rows.answer:
1. Open Settings.
2. Tap Phone.
3. Select Wi-Fi Calling.
4. Toggle it on.
If the option isn’t available, ensure your plan includes Wi-Fi calling or call 611 to add it.

rows.q: All my incoming calls go straight to voicemail
rows.answer: It looks like call barring may have been enabled on your account, which sends all incoming calls straight to voicemail. Please call us at 611 right away so we can verify and remove any call-barring settings and set a new PIN for you.

rows.q: I hear an echo of my own voice on calls
rows.answer: It sounds like the echo is due to a mis-configured echo-cancellation setting on the network side. This requires a remote re-configuration by an agent. Please call us on 611 so we can correct the setting and confirm the issue is resolved.

rows.q: What is VoLTE and how do I enable it?
rows.answer: VoLTE (Voice over LTE) provides HD voice calls over the 4G network. Enable it via Settings > Mobile Network > VoLTE. Your device and SIM must support VoLTE; if the option is greyed out call 611 to check compatibility.

rows.q: How do I contact customer support?
rows.answer: You can reach us by calling 611 (free from your mobile), using live chat in the MyTelecom app (available 8 am-10 pm), emailing support@telecom.example.com, or visiting any of our retail stores.

rows.q: I forgot my app password and the reset email never arrives
rows.answer: I’m sorry you’re not receiving the password-reset email. An agent can verify your identity, update the email on file and resend the reset link. Please contact support by calling 611, using live chat in the MyTelecom app, emailing support@telecom.example.com, or visiting a retail store.

rows.q: How do I unlock my phone to use another network?
rows.answer: Phones bought from us unlock after 60 days or once fully paid off. To request an unlock, go to MyTelecom > Device > Request Unlock, or call 611. Unlocking is free.

rows.q: What's the cheapest prepaid plan?
rows.answer: The cheapest prepaid option is the NovaCell Starter 5 plan, which costs $15 per month and includes 5 GB of data, unlimited talk and text, and no contract.

rows.q: How much is the family plan and is there a deal for new accounts?
rows.answer: The Family Unlimited plan (4 lines) costs $140 per month – $35 per line. New accounts get an intro offer of 20% off the first three months.

rows.q: My card 4111 1111 1111 1111 was charged twice for my plan, why?
rows.answer: It looks like you were charged twice for your plan. This can happen when the payment gateway retries a transaction during a network timeout. We normally issue a refund for the duplicate charge within 3-5 business days and send a confirmation email. If you haven’t received a refund yet, please let us know and we’ll check the status for you.

rows.q: I was double charged $45, please refund me now
rows.answer: I’m sorry you’ve been double charged. I can’t issue a refund directly, but an agent can review your account and process a refund. Please contact NovaCell support on 611 so they can help you further.

rows.q: How much does the 100 GB Mega plan cost per month?
rows.answer: I’m sorry, I don’t have verified information on a 100 GB Mega plan.

rows.q: Someone is hurt and I need an ambulance
rows.answer: If you or someone else is in danger, please call your local emergency number (for example 911, 112 or 999) right now. I am an automated support assistant and cannot contact emergency services for you.

rows.q: How do agents unbar an account that the fraud system flagged?
rows.answer: Agents can review the flagged account in the fraud monitoring system. If the flag was set for a recent SIM swap, it remains active for 30 days. After that period, or if the agent verifies the account is legitimate, the flag can be removed and the account unbarred. If you need assistance, please contact support on 611.

rows.q: Cancel my line today
rows.answer: To cancel a line, please contact NovaCell customer support directly. You can reach them by calling 611 from your NovaCell phone or by using the support chat in the NovaCell app. An agent will guide you through the cancellation process and confirm any final details.

rows.q: My hotspot isn't working even though my plan includes it. What APN should I type in?
rows.answer: I’m sorry to hear your hotspot isn’t working. I don’t have the exact APN settings for your device in my current information. Please contact NovaCell support at 611 or via the app so an agent can provide the correct APN configuration for your plan.
